label: lem5
title: Lemma
body_md:
\label{lem5}
For $r, n, p \in \mathbb N$, we have
\begin{align*}
H_n^{(p,r)}=\sum_{m=0}^{r-1} \sum_{j=0}^{r-1-m} a(r,m,j) n^{j} H_n^{(p-m)}\,.
\end{align*}
The coefficients $a(r,m,j)$ satisfy the following recurrence relations:
\begin{align*}
&a(r+1,r,0)=-\sum_{m=0}^{r-1} a(r,m,r-m-1)\frac{1}{r-m}\,,\\
&a(r+1,m,\ell)=\sum_{j=\ell-1}^{r-1-m} \frac{a(r,m,j)}{j+1} \binom{j+1}{j-\ell+1}B_{j-\ell+1}^{+}\\
&\qquad\qquad \qquad(0\leq m \leq r-1, 1\leq \ell \leq r-m)\,,\\
&a(r+1,m,0)=-\sum_{y=0}^{m} \sum_{j=max\{0, m-y-1\}}^{r-1-y}a(r,y,j)D(r,m,j,y)\quad (0\leq m \leq r-1)\,,
\end{align*}
where
$$
D(r,m,j,y)=\sum_{\ell=max\{0, m-y-1\}}^{j} \frac{1}{j+1} \binom{j+1}{j-\ell}B_{j-\ell}^{+}\binom{\ell+1}{m-y}(-1)^{1+\ell-m+y}\,.
$$
The initial value is given by $a(1,0,0)=1$.
